content:
jamie: Kicking off the tenant_metadata migration in tonight's 00:00-01:00 UTC change window. Pinned release v2026.03.21-db. Need a quick preflight + who's watching locks/latency.
 alex: Got it. Are we doing online backfill (rate-limited) or an offline job?
 jamie: Online backfill with rate cap 100 rows/s, canary 5% of tenants. We'll run deploybot canary then scale to 100% if metrics look good. Runbook updated: https://go/release/runbooks/mig-1778
 deploybot: deploybot: scheduled migration job claimed slot 00:15 UTC. Canary=5%, rate_limit=100 rows/s. Command queued:
 ```
 /start-migration --tenant-set=canary --migration=tenant_metadata_idx_swap --version=v2026.03.21-db --canary=0.05 --rate=100
 ```
 sophia: adding safety limits: abort if lock_count > 500 OR p99_db_latency increase > 200ms vs baseline. I'll watch. :eyes:
 jamie: Rollback criteria clarified: >0.5% user-facing error rate OR backfill tail > 2h -> rollback and revert middleware pin. Who's oncall?
 alex: @sophia is primary oncall for that window. sophia: can you take abort if needed?
 sophia: Can confirm. I'll also add a Grafana alert for lock_count > 200 to page immediately (we'll treat 200+ as early-warning). I'll be online from 23:45 UTC.
 deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks: SQL validation OK, shadow copy successful, index build plan uses concurrent algorithm, no exclusive locks expected. :white_check_mark:
 jamie: Quick SQL snippet for the index swap we're running (simplified):
 ```sql
BEGIN;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_tenant_meta_new ON tenant_metadata (tenant_id, updated_at);
-- backfill will insert into new index concurrently via batch worker
-- after backfill: ALTER TABLE tenant_metadata DROP CONSTRAINT old_idx_constraint;
COMMIT;
 ```
 alex: I'll pin app routing middleware to v2 in the canary service to avoid lookup changes. Applied patch to canary at 23:50 UTC.
 oncall-bot: oncall-bot: monitor rule created -> page sophia if lock_count > 200 OR migration_errors > 5 in 5m.
 jamie: One more: add release note blurb about possible transient 503 for small percentage during FK validate step. I'll put that in the release notes doc.
 sophia: If I see rising locks or p99 latency drift, plan: 1) /deploybot abort-migration <job-id> 2) revert middleware pin 3) run mitigation backfill from snapshot. I'll call timeout at 00:45 if backfill not progressed.
 alex: Logging snippet we'll watch (tail from backfill worker):
 ```
[2026-03-21T00:16:12Z] backfill.worker INFO batch_start tenant=canary rows=100
[2026-03-21T00:16:35Z] backfill.worker WARN lock_wait_ms=1200 qps=12
[2026-03-21T00:17:01Z] backfill.worker INFO batch_done rows=100 duration_ms=480
 ```
 jamie: Good. I'll be on standby to coordinate rollback decision. If sophia pages, we'll execute the rollback playbook.
 deploybot: deploybot: migration run scheduled at 00:12 UTC (job-id=job-1778882345). Good luck :rocket:
 alex: :thumbsup:
 sophia: Ready and monitoring.
